verdict.rationale: Azure has a centralized REST API reference hub (azure-docs-4, azure-docs-23), and the Cost Management service, a non-flagship service, has its own REST reference (azure-docs-14, azure-docs-22). The docs say most service REST APIs have client libraries (azure-docs-5), and the official Azure CLI is documented as covering Azure resource management (azure-docs-1, azure-probe-5), with one community report that 'almost everything can be done via command line' (azure-comm-15). However, nothing in the pack shows that reference depth and consistency hold across the whole service catalog. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-service CLI command reference coverage across all services, evidence of consistent reference format across services, and independent corroboration of reference quality for long-tail services.
